philosophy.notes: Editorial fashion-commerce posture is clear: full-bleed campaign image, quiet product modules, magazine-like copy rhythm, no SaaS framing.

hierarchy.notes: Hero headline anchors the first viewport; subsequent sections move from collection story to banner, best sellers, and journal with distinct scale changes.

execution.notes: Header state, overlays, hover actions, cart count, and responsive two-column mobile grid are implemented. Headless screenshot validation was blocked by local Chrome launch failure.

specificity.notes: Copy, product names, collection title, and visual language are specific to Maison Reverie and avoid copying the reference brand.

restraint.notes: Warm ivory, beige, blush, and charcoal are used with limited accent budget; decoration stays secondary to photography and product layout.
